feeds.title: Sandra's Closet
feeds.description: This website is about my true love FASHION. I want to share my passion with you, offer my own insights that I have earned through my fashion design studies, years working as a fashion editor. It features shopping guides on a current basis, designer profiles, upcoming style icons and gives an insight into Sandra's own closet.

feeds.title: Hey Pretty
feeds.description: The most exciting novelties from beauty, style, and hair, hand-picked and occasionally peppered with curse words. By Steffi Hidber - beauty industry insider.

feeds.title: Brandmarkt Blog
feeds.description: BrankMarkt is a brand store in St.Gallen with an exclusive collection. We have different collections for men, women, a wide range of shoes, bags and perfumes.

feeds.title: Chicandswiss
feeds.description: Lifestyle blogger from Lausanne, passionate about dance, culture and fashion who loves to share her blonde adventures.

feeds.title: les lynch
feeds.description: A Swiss Fashion & Lifestyle Blog. Author Charlene Lynch writes articles about Fashion, Beauty, and Lifestyle.

feeds.title: A Gentleman's World
feeds.description: A Gentleman's World by Ralph Widmer is about fashion, timepieces, cars and sophisticated luxuries of a modern gentleman.

feeds.title: Inattendu
feeds.description: Inattendu is a Swiss blog about fashion, style and travel, edited by Tine Fleischer, a German graphic designer living in Switzerland. Inattendu is known for representing especially up-and-coming designers and showcasing the freshest trends.

feeds.title: My Daily Looks
feeds.description: Wallace Yolicia is a Fashion Swiss Blogger sharing her street style by working with variety of brands from all around the world, to make women feel confident in various styles.

feeds.title: BellezaRebel Blog
feeds.description: I am a Swiss girl with an international heart. I Lived in 5 countries on 3 continents, Graduated in 2013 with an International Marketing & Events Management Degree and worked in this fascinating industry ever since. Grab your passport and follow me to my travel, beauty and event styling blog which will fill your heart with a daily dose of tips and inspiration!

feeds.title: Strawberries'n'Champagne
feeds.description: A fashion blog from Andrea Steiner based in Switzerland about trends, styling tips and personal favorites from the fashion world.

feeds.title: what would Miranda say?
feeds.description: An insomniac guy sharing his adventures in life & in fashion.

feeds.title: Monika Buser
feeds.description: Welcome to my Pretty Little World full of Fashion, Lifestyle and Beauty. I'm Luna, 21yrs old and from Switzerland. Enjoy this magical place to the fullest and collect new Inspirations

feeds.title: Furiously Chic
feeds.description: Laura is a Fashion blogger whose goal is to get you inspired each day. Sharing about fashion & life advice.'Everyday is a fashion show and the world is the runway.'

feeds.title: FunkyForty
feeds.description: This platform is aimed at the woman over 40 but not only. The mission is to stay young at heart by keeping up to date with latest trends. Nothing will make you older than the notion of having your style and not changing it!

feeds.title: Kayture
feeds.description: Kristina is a stylist, influencer, model and creative director, constantly traveling around the world with her partner in crime James. Founded in 2011 by Kristina Bazan and her partner James Chardon, Kayture is the most influencial fashion blog in Switzerland, and one of the biggest names worldwide.

feeds.title: Nissi Mendes
feeds.description: Hi, I am Nissi Mendes born in Switzerland and have Portuguese roots. On my blog, I dedicate myself to my passion - the fashion. I am also happy to blog about beauty, travel and about everything that just moves me.
